title: Fusion Generator Supply Tanks
caption: Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (V)
game_text: Deploy on a docking bay or your capital starship. Star Destroyers and unique (•) TIEs are immune to attrition < 3. May place this device in Lost Pile to cancel Hyper Escape or Power Pivot. If opponent controls this location, place this device in Used Pile.
lore: Installed at many facilities throughout the Empire to provide power to the Imperial spacefleet. Supplies starships with energy necessary for sub-light and hyperspace travel.
